result.brief: 提出基于投影采样 MPC 与贝叶斯代价调优的双臂操作规划框架，属于机器人规划控制，不涉及世界模型或表征学习贡献。
result.reason: Main contribution is a sampling-based MPC planner with QP projection and Bayesian cost tuning for bimanual robot manipulation; the physics simulator is used only as a tool, not a learned world model or representation.
